scope: Independent bounded static crosscheck of complete actual CODE findings; root owns disposition/release

findings.evidence: Confirmed: real config.bdptest contains deploymentFile, but exact nested allowlist accepts fixture only. A structurally assignable real section is refused before open. Current loader is still an isolated future-consumer seam; this is a concrete integration hazard, not evidence that an existing listener ran.
findings.recommendation: Accept deploymentFile in nested type/allowlist, preserve fixture conflict; witness deploymentFile-only success and fixture+deploymentFile refusal. If equality is added, make the chosen policy explicit.

findings.evidence: Confirmed public SHA identities commit to secret-containing content. Existing accepted provenance permits them; absence of literal tokens in JSON does not imply secrecy.
findings.recommendation: Accept documentation saying digests commit to contents and must not be diagnostic-emitted. Do not introduce a salting/hash-identity change under this bounded correction.

findings.evidence: Confirmed TX loopback is a duplicate literal, currently equal to the authoritative default.
findings.recommendation: Reuse TRANSACTION_RUNTIME_DEFAULTS.transport.host; preserve existing accepted host behavior.

findings.evidence: Confirmed duplicate page formula. Reviewer proposed relying solely on the postcapture check, which would move unsupported-limit refusal after file access and conflicts with the accepted pre-file refusal order.
findings.recommendation: Retain the explicit pre-file unsupported tuple refusal and authoritative captured readOptions comparison. Defer abstraction unless both timing and current behavior stay explicit.

findings.evidence: Confirmed heartbeat check duplicates liveStreamsAvailable and seams is empty at this call site. Harmless future-refactor tripwires.
findings.recommendation: Retain/defer or explain briefly; no correctness blocker.

findings.evidence: Confirmed unconditional 32 MiB+1 allocation (33,554,433 bytes), bounded and intentional; stat is not the real growth bound.
findings.recommendation: Retain/defer. Optional future allocation optimization must preserve one-handle reads, stale-stat growth ceiling and close discipline; no bound change now.

findings.evidence: Confirmed calls.length is only used as a no-reread baseline and close spy uses mockImplementationOnce; neither proves exactly one open.
findings.recommendation: Accept an explicit exactly-one-open assertion, resetting/isolating counts appropriately.

findings.evidence: Confirmed mutation targets page.maximumItems but assertions omit preflightReadLimits; MAX+1 refusal exists, exact-MAX acceptance and empty syntax are not in these witnesses.
findings.recommendation: Accept preflightReadLimits snapshot assertion and a small empty-file syntax witness. Exact-MAX accept is optional; if added use a valid envelope plus trailing whitespace to isolate the outer byte boundary.

findings.evidence: Confirmed equivalent path grammar across the package boundary. Server does not depend on config; duplicate validation is structurally justified.
findings.recommendation: Retain/defer or cross-reference comments; do not add a new runtime/package dependency.

findings.evidence: Confirmed fixed non-echo code policy: explicit internal refuses remain internal; arbitrary capture defects under contract phase are masked as contract. No demonstrated boundary breach.
findings.recommendation: Retain/defer; optional error policy prose, no new semantics needed.
